problem:
Consider the matrix differential equation 

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]x(t)+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {e}^{2t}\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following vectors are solutions to this equation?

$$
{x}_{1}(t)=[\begin{aligned}{e}^{t} \\ {e}^{2t}\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{2}(t)=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {e}^{t}\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}(t)=[\begin{aligned}{e}^{t} \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
